text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Statin use vs death rate from cardiovascular diseases 2019
The use of statins in the population, measured in Defined Daily Doses per 1,000 people. This is compared to the
reported annual death rate from cardiovascular diseases per 100,000 people, based on the underlying cause
Cardiovascular diseases death rate (deaths per 100,000 people)
Statin use (DDD (defined daily doses) per 1000 population)

tspan.tspan: Guadamuz, Shooshtari and Qato (2022); WHO Mortality Database (2025)
To allow for comparisons between countries and over time, the metrics are age-standardized. Statin use was estimated from purchases

text.tspan: by stores and hospitals and, in special cases like the United Kingdom, data on prescriptions for patients. All deaths in a country may not have
been registered with a cause of death. Where data for 2019 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2014 and 2023 is shown
